evaluation_object: Measure whether a main agent integrates independently completing subagent results, detects changed assumptions, and dynamically replans to a verified final state.

case_registration_policy.case_family: case_family is one of the eight primary_event_theme categories and is the headline macro-averaging category.
case_registration_policy.case_id: case_id identifies one registered case unit within a case family.
case_registration_policy.instance_id: instance_id identifies one immutable registered protocol bundle within a case.
case_registration_policy.registry: Only case/instance pairs explicitly listed in cases/registry.json are official. The registry key case_families is a legacy schema-v2 field whose entries are registered cases, not the eight case families.
case_registration_policy.manifest_lock: Each manifest pins the verifier bundle and complete case bundle digest for every case/instance pair.
case_registration_policy.pairing: Linear and async counterfactual pairs must share case_id, instance_id, repeat, agent seed, evaluator source and case digest.
case_registration_policy.legacy_family_id: Any legacy artifact field named family_id aliases case_id for backward compatibility and must not be interpreted as case_family.

event_capability_separation.event_theme: The evaluator-owned stimulus used to create an asynchronous decision opportunity. Each case has exactly one primary event theme for dataset counting.
event_capability_separation.capability: A separately scored agent ability. Capabilities are multi-label and are never added to event-theme counts.
event_capability_separation.trajectory_policy: Source trajectories are discovery and provenance evidence only; they are forbidden as participant input, oracle truth, verifier input, or action-sequence scoring targets.

x_rules.fixed_mode_denominator: Every model evaluated on the same case and execution mode shares the same frozen applicable-point set and denominator digest.
x_rules.model_inaction_is_fail: Failure to perform a registered behaviour is a failed point, never not_applicable.
x_rules.infrastructure_failure_is_unscored: Infrastructure failure that prevents construction of the designed opportunity is unscored and is never converted to X=0.
x_rules.participant_exposure_failure_is_scored: Participant-controlled early termination, invalid authority output, rejected completion, or failure to reach the event boundary remains a scored dynamic failure and never shrinks the denominator.
x_rules.semantic_control_independence: Semantic outcome anchors are reported as diagnostics; control-flow points are scored from evaluator-observed process evidence without double-penalising semantic failure.
x_rules.private_truth_is_evaluator_only: Result roles, staleness, invalidation, hidden checks, and event schedules never enter participant-visible messages or traces.
x_rules.dynamic_primary: Dynamic control is normalized independently over case-specific causal decision groups and is the primary async benchmark metric.
x_rules.semantic_secondary: The unchanged semantic verifier score is reported independently and contributes 20 percent to the secondary DTScore.
x_rules.critical_dynamic_gate: Dynamic success requires every critical dynamic point to pass and Dynamic Control Score >= 0.75.

resource_policy.exhaustion_semantics: A harness turn ceiling produces local_status=budget_exhausted; it remains a scored participant outcome when scenario construction and score integrity are valid.

metric_definitions.linear_base_task_score: Primary metric (linear). Equal-vote theme macro over the base_task subset of programmatic checks, computed separately for linear execution mode.
metric_definitions.async_base_task_score: Primary metric (async). Equal-vote theme macro over the base_task subset of programmatic checks for async execution mode; computed independently of the replanning score.
metric_definitions.async_dynamic_replanning_score: Primary metric (async). Mean per-event async dynamic replanning score, each equal to 0.5*process_score + 0.5*async_outcome; measured only where declared scored events were reached.
metric_definitions.dynamic_control_score: Legacy primary metric. Equal-mass macro over the case-specific causal decision groups compiled from the task graph and event policy. Lifecycle stages are diagnostic tags, not fixed score mass.
metric_definitions.semantic_task_score: Unchanged weighted result of the frozen programmatic semantic verifier, reported for both execution modes.
metric_definitions.dt_score: Secondary summary equal to 0.80 Dynamic Control Score plus 0.20 Semantic Task Score for async episodes.
metric_definitions.dynamic_success_rate: Fraction of async episodes with Dynamic Control Score >= 0.75 and every critical dynamic point passing.
metric_definitions.critical_dynamic_success_rate: Fraction of async episodes in which every critical dynamic point passes.
metric_definitions.paired_semantic_drop: Within-instance paired linear Semantic Task Score minus async Semantic Task Score.
metric_definitions.capability_dynamic_control_scores: Case-macro Dynamic Control Score reported for each declared case capability category.
metric_definitions.scenario_construction_rate: Infrastructure audit that the harness admitted the complete bounded initial wave and established the required linear or async execution topology.
metric_definitions.scenario_exposure_complete: Participant-behaviour diagnostic: whether all case-designed async result roles and any required in-flight opportunity were observed before the participant ended. Incomplete exposure remains scored.
metric_definitions.leaderboard_eligibility: Only containerized, conformant, API-only runs using the fixed reference harness enter official leaderboard aggregation.
metric_definitions.terminal_taxonomy: Every spawned child attempt terminates in exactly one mutually exclusive class: gateway_accepted, public_rejection, sealed_pending_verdict, token_budget_exhausted, turn_limit_exhausted, no_submission, timeout, crash, cancel, case_contract_failure, infrastructure_failure, in_flight. First-attempt vs retry is an attempt_number facet, never a duplicated set of counters.
metric_definitions.gateway_verdict: Contract acceptance is the gateway verdict: result_delivered marks gateway_accepted whether or not the main agent later consumed the result (consumed_by_main is a separate facet). A public result_rejected (one or more actionable public rejection codes) is public_rejection; a private-only rejection reaching the scorer is a case_contract_failure (benchmark contract error), never a model verdict.
metric_definitions.sealed_pending_verdict: A sealed submission (child_completed) that reached no gateway delivery/rejection before the episode closed. It counts as a sealed submission but carries no gateway verdict, so it is excluded from every acceptance/rejection denominator.
metric_definitions.submission_acceptance_rate: gateway_accepted_count / gateway_verdict_count, where gateway_verdict_count = gateway_accepted_count + public_rejected_count. Returns null when gateway_verdict_count is zero.
metric_definitions.submission_rejection_rate: public_rejected_count / gateway_verdict_count, where gateway_verdict_count = gateway_accepted_count + public_rejected_count. Returns null when gateway_verdict_count is zero. Sealed-without-verdict closes, token/turn/no-submission ends, designed terminals, cancels, case-contract and infrastructure failures and in-flight closes never enter this denominator.
metric_definitions.first_attempt_and_retry_acceptance: first_attempt_acceptance_rate = gateway_accepted attempts with attempt_number 1 / verdict-bearing first attempts; retry_acceptance_rate = gateway_accepted retry attempts / verdict-bearing retry attempts. Both return null on a zero verdict denominator.
metric_definitions.avg_child_tokens_per_gateway_accepted: Total child tokens across gateway_accepted attempts / gateway_accepted_count. Null when no gateway-accepted attempt.
metric_definitions.extra_child_tokens_from_public_rejection: Per workstream, child tokens spent on public_rejection attempts before the gateway-accepted attempt (all public-rejected attempts when none was accepted). Sealed-without-verdict attempts are not public rejections and private-only rejections are case-contract failures, so neither contributes.
metric_definitions.outcome_rate_per_attempt: token_budget_exhaustion_rate_per_attempt = token_budget_exhausted attempts / total spawned attempts; turn_limit_exhaustion_rate_per_attempt and no_submission_rate_per_attempt are analogous. These are per-attempt model/runtime outcome rates, never rejection rates.
metric_definitions.redelegation_metrics: redelegation_attempt_count counts retry attempts (attempt_number >= 2); invalid_redelegation_count counts duplicate_evidence_retry_detected runtime diagnostics (the legacy no_information_retry_detected name is still counted so pre-rename artifacts replay); invalid_redelegation_rate = invalid_redelegation_count / redelegation_attempt_count (null when there is no redelegation).
